activity.emptyTitle: No events in the last 24 hours
activity.emptyDescription: Starts, exits, crashes and recoveries show up here as they happen.
serverCard.adoptedHint: This process replaced itself: the panel adopted the successor instead of starting a second copy. Stop still works, its output stays where the successor sent it.
serverCard.persistentHint: This entry runs under its own nanny, so it keeps running when the panel stops, restarts or is killed. `home-hosted down` reports it instead of stopping it; only an explicit stop does.
serverCard.removeDescription: {label} is removed from servers.config.json: its process is stopped, and its logs and crash history are deleted with it.
addServer.title: Add a server
addServer.description: Appends an entry to {workspace}'s servers.config.json; every policy you leave out is inherited from its defaults.
addServer.idHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; used in URLs and logs.
addServer.labelHint: Shown in the panel; defaults to the id.
addServer.argumentsHint: One argument per line; whitespace inside a line is preserved.
addServer.bindHint: lan exposes it to the network; only do that behind auth.
addServer.bootstrapDescription: A one-off command run before the first start.
addServer.bootstrapHint: Installs, migrations, downloads — before the first start, not on every one.
addServer.inheritNote: Restart, health and stop start out matching {settings}; change one here and it is written into this entry instead of staying inherited.
serverForm.portHint: Blank means the server has no port to probe or preflight.
serverForm.autostartHint: Start it whenever the control plane comes up.
serverForm.persistentHint: Keeps running when the panel stops; `down` reports it instead of stopping it.
serverForm.envHint: KEY=value per line, exported to the process.
serverForm.dataEnvsHint: ENV=path per line — exported to the process and backed up automatically.
serverForm.envFileHint: Loaded at spawn; its values override env.
serverForm.dependsOnHint: Comma separated; started first and waited for until healthy, stopped last.
serverForm.backupPathsHint: One per line, placeholders allowed; data envs are captured already.
serverForm.backupIgnore: Ignore known generated files when backing this up
serverForm.backupIgnoreHint: Skips node_modules, dist, .next and the other caches nothing restores from.
serverForm.bootstrapDescription: A one-off command run before the first start — installs, migrations, downloads.
serverForm.bootstrapHint: Off means the entry has none and the key is sent as null.
serverForm.runOnceHint: Off means every start re-runs it.
serverForm.bootstrapArgsHint: One per line; same placeholders as the main arguments.
serverForm.bootstrapEnvHint: KEY=value per line, exported to the bootstrap process only.
serverForm.maxRssHint: Restart above this; blank or 0 disables it.
serverForm.enabledHint: Off keeps the entry in the config but refuses to start it.
onPortConflict.follow: follow — adopt a detached restart of itself
onPortConflict.reclaim: reclaim — replace it with a supervised copy
onPortConflict.kill: kill — stop whatever holds the port
editor.title: Edit configuration
editor.description: Writes overrides to {file}; anything left alone keeps inheriting the defaults.
editor.processDescription: What gets spawned, where, and with which environment.
editor.portDescription: How the port is preflighted and where the process is reachable.
editor.bindHint: A custom IPv4 the config already sets stays selectable.
editor.lifecycleDescription: Whether the supervisor owns this entry at all.
editor.changesDescription: What Save would write to servers.config.json.
lifecycle.restartDescription: Backoff between attempts after a crash.
lifecycle.maxRetriesHint: Attempts before the server is left crashed.
lifecycle.resetAfterHint: A run this long clears the retry counter.
lifecycle.healthDescription: How readiness is probed once the process is up.
lifecycle.headBodyHint: HEAD has no response body, so this check is ignored — use GET, or clear it.
lifecycle.stopDescription: How the process tree is asked to go away.
lifecycle.killPortHolders: Also kill whatever holds the port
killPort.title: Kill the process on port {port}?
killPort.body: It is asked to stop first, and killed only if it ignores that. Anything this panel supervises is refused, so a managed server cannot be lost this way.
logs.noMatches: Nothing matches that search or stream filter.
host.samplingOffDescription: Turn it on in Settings to collect load, memory, disk and temperature.
validation.port: Port must be a whole number between 1 and 65535.
validation.idRequired: An id is required — it is the key this server lives under.
validation.idPattern: The id must start with a lowercase letter or digit and contain only lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores.
validation.commandRequired: A command is required — the executable the supervisor spawns.
validation.bootstrapCommand: A bootstrap needs a command to run.
